parameters.name: Domains
parameters.description:
The domain names of the website services.

> The domain names must have website service forwarding rules configured. You can call [DescribeDomains](~~91724~~) to query all domain names.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance belongs in Resource Management. This parameter is empty by default, which indicates that the instance belongs to the default resource group.
